subject: Coord: demo time pressure across US/EU/APAC — Diwali overlap, need reschedule approach
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@fastretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@fastretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 07:02:00 +0000
Subject: Scheduling demo with worldwide stakeholders (timing constraints)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for following up. We're excited to see Redwood's runtime in action. Our team for this proof-of-concept includes stakeholders across NA (NY), EU (Berlin), and APAC (Mumbai + Sydney). That's four timezones to juggle.

A quick note on availability constraints: several of our APAC leads are OOO for Diwali next week (we expect reduced coverage Nov 11–13), and one of our EU product owners will be at a year-end planning offsite Nov 16–18. We need a single session that covers both product and a 20–30 minute technical deep dive with your SE, or — if that's not possible — two shorter sessions split by region.

Can you propose slots that (a) avoid the APAC Diwali blackout, (b) take into account that US clocks just changed (DST ended in early Nov) which shifted overlap windows, and (c) avoid late-evening times for our EU folks? We prefer a consolidated session if feasible.

Attaching a short internal agenda and the list of attendees.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Integrations
FastRetail

Attachments: FastRetail_internal_attendees.csv (stub), draft_agenda.txt (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@fastretail.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@fastretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo with worldwide stakeholders (timing constraints)

Hi Priya — really appreciate the heads-up on Diwali and the EU offsite. I pulled together a couple of options after checking team OOO and DST offsets:

Option A — Single consolidated session (75 mins)
- Proposed: Tue, Nov 23 at 16:00 UTC (this lands at 11:00 ET, 17:00 CET, 21:30 IST, 01:00 AEST next day for Sydney).
- Pros: one meeting for all stakeholders, preserves context and momentum for a single POC kickoff.
- Cons: late for Sydney; may be outside working hours for some APAC attendees — we recommend recording and scheduling a short APAC-only follow-up if attendance is low.

Option B — Two focused sessions (recommended if APAC can't join live)
- EU/US session: Wed, Nov 24 at 15:00 UTC (10:00 ET / 16:00 CET) — product + 20m SE QA.
- APAC session: Thu, Nov 25 at 04:00 UTC (09:30 IST / 14:30 AEST) — shorter, tailored demo and recorded material.
- Pros: respects working hours, gives SE time to deep-dive with APAC in their local morning.

Notes on DST/offsets: US ended DST on Nov 7; EU follows earlier in Oct — offsets are now stable but the one-week mismatch created earlier confusion; I rechecked everything against UTC.

Karthik, can you confirm SE availability for the two-session plan (especially Nov 25 early UTC)? Soojin, are there APAC product leads who can take part in the early-morning session if needed?

Priya — if you prefer Option A for single-context benefit, we can add a short APAC catch-up and provide a recording. If Option B looks better, we'll send two invites and merge materials.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: FastRetail_demo_agenda.pdf (stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo with worldwide stakeholders (timing constraints)

Looping in briefly — thanks for options, Vanessa. A couple operational points: 

- For enterprise prospects like FastRetail we should prioritize two things: (1) ensure the SE can attend at least one live deep-dive per region, and (2) send the recording + a timeboxed follow-up office hour to capture any asynchronous Qs.
- Karthik: if Nov 25 (early UTC) is tight, propose an alternate APAC slot on Nov 26 morning IST — still before Australia's working day ramps up.
- Please prepare an attendee-specific agenda: mark which slides/demo segments are mandatory for product stakeholders vs SE-only. That helps people join for the parts relevant to them.

I don't want us to force a single 75-min session if it materially reduces APAC participation. Customer momentum is important, but so is getting the right folks in the room.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:40:00 +0000

Thanks everyone — Option B (two focused sessions) works best for our group given the Diwali blackout and a few tight EU calendars. Let's lock these: 

- EU/US session: Wed, Nov 24 at 15:00 UTC — product + 20m SE QA (we've confirmed product owners).
- APAC session: Fri, Nov 26 at 04:00 UTC / 09:30 IST — APAC product & infra folks will join that morning local time.

Karthik — please accept the APAC invite if you can (I attached the two .ics files). Vanessa — thanks for offering the recording; please share slides and recording promptly.

Looking forward — Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Integrations
FastRetail
